subject.size_in_frame: about 0.56 of frame height — closer than sh049, but the bottle is still held beside her as the gauge

second_subject.note: still level with her crown, still sharp; the moment it leaves the frame the size stops being provable, so it does not leave.

headroom: about 0.20 of frame height, and her flat hand on top of her head reduces it visibly — the gesture is composed to eat the headroom, which is exactly what she is afraid of.
horizon_eyeline: Lens at 0.20 m on the flags: flagstone joint across the bottom at 0.88 of frame height. Her eyeline is at 0.46 and goes nowhere — she is looking at nothing while she waits.

layers.fg: the flagstone surface and the mosaic dado border at her own scale
layers.mg: Alice with one hand flat on top of her head, and the bottle beside her
layers.bg: the glass legs and the lit tabletop plane above, soft-edged but sharp

gaze.note: her eyes go up under her own hand — the smallest possible version of the sh049 look. The nervousness is in the waiting, so the lead room above her stays empty and nothing enters it.

balance: Two vertical objects of equal height in the lower half, a wide dark upper half. Almost the sh049 balance, tightened — the frame has moved closer without conceding the gauge.
leading_lines: Her forearm bent over her own crown makes a small closed loop at the top of the figure; it is the only curve in a frame of verticals, and it is where the eye is meant to stop.
eye_first: The flat hand on her head, then the bottle beside her for the comparison.
constraint_binding: The hand flat on the head is the whole performance: the composition offers nothing else to watch — no reframe, no reaction cut, no second gesture — and the nervousness lives in the duration of an unchanging frame. Deep focus, both gauges sharp.
